labs.location: Barnum Hall, 163 Packard Ave., Medford, MA 02155
labs.research_summary: Nonpartisan research center in Tufts' Tisch College that produces Massachusetts policy reports and ballot question guides.
labs.join_notes: The Jobs page describes a full-time hourly Summer Research Associate role (8 to 10 weeks, pay up to $10,000) to manage the 2026 ballot question briefs. Applicants email a cover letter and resume to Andrea LeSaffre (andrea.lesaffre@tufts.edu). The posting refers to summer 2026 and may be out of date.
labs.notes: The people page shows only the executive director and an advisory council, so no staff count was recorded. Andrea LeSaffre's role is not given.
